title: Item:Boarding Pass: Sharn
wikitext:
{{Nonconsumable | name = Boarding Pass: Sharn | picdesc = Boarding Pass Sharn.png | acquired = [[Shinshea]] | location = Eberron [[Hall of Heroes]] | minlevel = 1 | bind = {{Bind|BtA|BoA}} | effect = Clicky: {{Clicky|Expanded Teleport|7|no|N/A}} | cost = 300 pp | weight = 0.01 lbs | stack = 1 | description = Present your papers, please, and be granted entrance to the city of Sharn!

This item is capable of Teleporting you to a variety of locations depending on what you've unlocked.

This item has a one-minute cooldown to re-arrange your papers. | notes = ** Ownership of this item unlocks the following destinations for Expanded Teleport: *** [[Sharn - Clifftop Tower District|Clifftop Tower District]] (at the top near the Part One questgivers) *** [[Sharn - Cliffside Docks District|Sharn Docks]] (near the [[Alchemical Crafting]] forges and Soul Splitter questgivers) *** Drunken Dragon tavern (again in the Clifftop Tower District, near the favor and saga NPCs and Part Two questgivers) *** [[Alcorin's Forge - Staging Area]] (location of the Sharn raids) ** As of [[Update 80]], the cooldown is 20 seconds, but {{bug|this is not reflected in the description|term=}}. }}
